projects.title: AI Pipeline Container — Multi-Modal Audio Processing System
projects.description: Production-ready, containerized AI pipeline for processing audio recordings into structured insights. Built for child protection organizations to transform call recordings into actionable case analysis. Full pipeline: audio → transcription → translation → NLP analysis → structured output. GPU-accelerated with Celery task queuing and real-time status updates.

projects.title: AI-Powered Enterprise Knowledge Management System
projects.description: AI-powered Enterprise Knowledge Management System built for a government energy organisation. Contributed 14+ commits covering API caching, DB pool tuning, search optimization, demo data packs, and full upload pipeline integration tests.

projects.title: Travel Management SaaS
projects.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for corporate travel management: authorization requests, advances, in-trip expense capture, expense reports, and reimbursement. Contributed 18+ commits across employee management, donor/contribution modules, GL account mapping, and bulk user onboarding. PoC shipped at v0.1.0.

projects.title: Azui Billing System
projects.description: Enterprise billing platform. Contributed 16+ commits to the Java/Spring Boot backend: customer portal authentication (email/phone login), duplicate data enforcement, DTO-based API responses, and integration-level self-review practices.

projects.title: OpenCHS — AI-Powered Case Management Platform
projects.description: Contributed to OpenCHS, an open-source AI-enabled helpline and case management platform serving child protection organizations across East Africa. Work spanned AI integration, backend development, government system integrations, and production deployments in 5 countries.

projects.title: OpenCHS Child Friendly Feedback System
projects.description: Contributed to the OpenCHS child-friendly feedback module, including location mapping fixes (codes → human-readable names), CPIMS category mapping with strict validation, and production bug resolution.

projects.title: Government & Institutional API Integrations
projects.description: Built REST API integrations between OpenCHS and government/institutional systems: Uganda Ministry of Gender (MGLSD) gateway for child protection data exchange, and Kenya CPIMS for interoperability with the national child protection registry.
projects.organization: BITZ IT Consulting Ltd. / Uganda MGLSD / CPIMS Kenya

projects.title: Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Initiative
projects.description: A broader Digital Public Infrastructure initiative spanning multiple interconnected platforms: D-HEIGHT (housing & settlements), D-Learn (education), D-Health (healthcare), D-Social (social services), and more. Each pillar is designed as a composable DPI layer covering housing, financial inclusion, WASH, marketplace, governance, citizen participation, and responsible AI. Currently in the research and design phase — implementation ahead.

projects.title: Church SaaS Platform
projects.description: Personal project — a SaaS platform for churches combining livestreaming, sermons, events, digital giving, and church management. Built UI features across navbar, events, sermons, live streaming, and giving modules.

projects.title: NorthStar AI — Career Companion

projects.title: ISP Management System
